method: Instruction-level interpreter with simulated HSC CH3; GX Works3 compile and real FX5U NOT verified

tests.name: Power up: motor OFF, READY lamp on, HSC CH3 started, PPR=600
START held while powering up does not run the motor
Press START: motor runs and stays on after release (seal-in), RUN lamp
Press STOP: motor stops and stays stopped
STOP and START pressed together: STOP wins
Holding START does not restart after STOP (edge only)
Broken STOP wire (NC open) stops motor and blocks START
Overload trips: motor stops, FAULT flashes, no restart until reset
RESET with overload still open keeps the fault
Encoder: count follows HSC, 1 rev = 600 counts, Y13 half-on/half-off
Encoder speed: 600 counts/s = 60 rpm forward, reverse gives negative rpm
Encoder reverse below zero: revs/remainder and Y13 stay consistent
RESET clears the encoder count to 0
Encoder works whether the motor is running or not (independent study encoder)
PPR = 0 entered by mistake: no divide-by-zero, Y13 off
